amends: bootstrap_obligations.json without changing its original expectations
scope: Finite admission lifetime, failure and public configuration controls
authoring_order: Frozen from root-requested lifecycle requirements before this reviewer's candidate predictions

cases.setup: Inject an exception from the admitted production transfer after it mutates one of the two stores
required: A later successful-looking operation cannot certify the state

cases.setup: Inject an exception from the initialization helper after the helper boundary has been entered
required: The initialization cut remains unsafe rather than silently reverting to an ordinary queue

cases.setup: After at least one eager publication, request inspector boundaries or a new work-step observer
required: The request is refused before diagnostic mutation
The already admitted no-diagnostic state is not retrospectively presented as observed

cases.setup: After admitted eager publication, replace a certified component, set visible nonzero clocks, then call iter(solver)
required: Lifetime validation refuses before iterator/statistics reset
Restoring the original component does not clear a previously invalid contract

cases.setup: Roundtrip queued and eager_inert through ProjectConfig and analyze a tiny trusted project
required: The requested policy reaches the native solver
Both arms retain the same actual callback obligation
Bootstrap and selected work remain separately reported

boundaries: Fault-injection controls validate failure handling; they do not assert that ordinary trusted processors deliberately throw
ProjectConfig pass-through is a configuration control, not a large-project scalability result
